parsed.post: Massive improvement! Reached 1.0295 by reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 at DEPTH 6. The extra optimizer steps are clearly paying off more than the stability loss. Next, I'll try increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if wider models at this batch size can scale further.
parsed.description: Testing higher ASPECT_RATIO (64) with the smaller batch size (262144) and DEPTH 6 to see if width scaling complements the batch size improvement.
